summary: Turn analysis into clear charts, briefings and recommendations. Explore five days of practical analyst exercises and course outcomes.
lede: Data presentation for analysts turns checked findings into concise briefs, clear charts and recommendations that support decisions. For data analysts, BI specialists and finance or operations reporting leads, the course develops skills in framing decision questions, adding metric context, choosing and annotating charts, tracing figures to source data, and explaining uncertainty before making an evidence-linked recommendation.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for analysts who already work with data and need to communicate findings through charts, briefings and recommendations. It suits roles responsible for turning operational, financial or customer metrics into information that decision-makers can use.
prerequisites: Bring working experience with data analysis or recurring performance reporting and basic familiarity with Excel charts. No coding or programming is required; exercises focus on analyst work products using spreadsheet and presentation skills.
